title: What a wonderful journey!
text: Hello! I'm a cardboard box. I got here in the morning. What will they do with me? Will they throw me away? Oh no!
In the afternoon, they picked me up and put me in a recycling bin. Then I got on a truck. There I made friends with plastic cups, plastic bottles and glass bottles.
